thread:
sre-alex: Heads up — BrightLayer reported repeated 429s + latency spikes on their Dedicated pool this morning. Looks like scale up/down happening every ~3-4m.

support-kim: Customer repro and logs attached in the support ticket: https://redwood.support/t/BL-4823
They see 429s and request timeouts for ~90s windows.

oncall-bot: ALERT: dedicated-autoscale:brightlayer pool - 72x 429s in 15m, scale events: up->down->up x6.

eng-runtime-li: Can you paste the exact autoscaler config for that pool? My hunch: cooldown/hysteresis too short + bursty input -> thrash. Also check batching backlog metric.

support-kim: From customer (sanitized):
```
pool: brightlayer-dedicated-1
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 10
scale_up_threshold_qps: 120
scale_down_threshold_qps: 60
scale_up_cooldown_s: 90
scale_down_cooldown_s: 45
```
They said typical traffic arrives in 30s spikes from their webhook fanout.

sre-priya: If down cooldown is 45s that's probably the culprit — system sees QPS drop after a burst then immediately scales down, then a new burst occurs and we scale up again. Need hysteresis. Suggest: increase scale_down_cooldown_s to 300 and add a 3m grace window for rapid-recovery traffic.

eng-runtime-li: Agreed. Also add a rolling average on QPS for 60s window (instead of instant) on that pool; and set min_replicas=2 for now so single-node noisy neighbor doesn't starve pooling.

cs-jordan: Customer is asking for ETA to stop the 429s. If we change cooldown to 300s and bump min_replicas to 2, how fast can we deploy?

sre-alex: Can push change to autoscaler config for that pool as a targeted hotfix — ~10m once approved. We'll monitor. I'll draft the change and a quick rollback.

eng-runtime-li: Proposed patch (testing in staging):
```
PATCH /v1/admin/pools/brightlayer-dedicated-1
{
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "scale_down_cooldown_s": 300,
  "scale_up_cooldown_s": 120,
  "qps_window_s": 60
}
```
Validation: run load profile with 30s fanout -> expect no more than 1 scale down in <5m period.

support-kim: Also saw these log snippets on the nodes during thrash:
```
2026-10-12T09:12:34Z [runtime] batch_backlog=172 queue_latency_ms=1100 scale_event=scale_down
2026-10-12T09:13:10Z [runtime] request_rate=5 qps_avg_10s=48
2026-10-12T09:13:45Z [runtime] scale_event=scale_up reason=qps_burst
```
Queue latency >1s during some windows - that will cause 429s when capacity toggles.

sre-priya: Good catch. We should also temporarily increase per-node concurrency limit and enable KV cache warming for that pool to avoid regen penalty after scale up.

cs-jordan: Customer ok with hotfix, wants proactive note when deployed.

sre-alex: Rolling patch to prod at 11:30 UTC for brightlayer pool. Will set alert mute for noisy churn and attach runbook steps.

eng-runtime-li: After patch deployed, run this smoke repro locally (from an app VM):
```
for i in {1..40}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @payload.json &
  sleep 0.75
done
```
payload.json: single 128-token prompt repeated to emulate webhook burst. Watch scale events in admin UI.

oncall-bot: RUNBOOK NOTE created: rb-5678 -> "Dedicated pool thrash mitigation". Include steps to revert cooldown and min_replicas.

support-kim: I'll update the ticket and tell customer the mitigation plan + expected monitor window (2h).

cs-jordan: Thanks — please ping me when smoothing is live so I can close the loop. :thumbsup:

sre-alex: Patch applied at 11:36 UTC. Initial telemetry: scale events dropped by 90% in first 30m, 429s stopped. Still monitoring for queue latency regressions.

eng-runtime-li: Leaving this for follow-up: we should add an autoscaler policy type "burst-aware" that looks at burst frequency and enforces a minimum cooldown based on burst rate. Filing ticket.

cs-jordan: Customer confirmed improved behavior after 45m. They wanted the config as a reference — attaching updated pool settings to ticket.

sre-priya: Marking thread resolved for now. We'll keep watch for 24h. :white_check_mark:

sre-alex: Closing after 24h clean window. If it recurs we'll reopen and do deeper noisy-neighbor/live profile capture.
